player_prompt.intro:
Ko'o Player {player_id} e derewol Indian Poker.
- 52-kawtal kawtal; ko'o yi'i kawtal jarga e.
- Kuugal {ante} chip(s) e kowgal, {max_rounds} kowgal(s) piro.
- Yi'i e derewol: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ko wakkati e dow laawol ≤ e chip mool.)
- Kawtal yi'i e dow e poti e showdown.
